title: Symbolic Branch Networks: Tree-Inherited Neural Models for Interpretable Multiclass Classification
abstract: arXiv:2507.01781v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Symbolic Branch Networks (SBNs) are neural models whose architecture is derived directly from an ensemble of decision trees. Each root-to-parent-of-leaf decision path is mapped to a hidden neuron, while the matrices W1 (feature-to-branch) and W2 (branch-to-class) encode the structural relationships induced by the teacher ensemble. This provides an explicit correspondence between teacher branches and neural components, enabling feature-level and branch-level interpretation while retaining the flexibility of gradient-based optimization. The primary configuration studied in this work trains the teacher-derived feature-to-branch matrix W1 through gradient-based learning while keeping the branch-to-class matrix W2 fixed; this configuration is denoted SBN1,0. Across 29 multiclass tabular datasets, this configuration improves upon the teacher ensemble on 28 of 29 datasets, increasing mean accuracy from 84.0% to 87.9%. For reference, X

translated_title: 符号分支网络：用于可解释多分类的树继承神经模型
translated_abstract: 符号分支网络是一种其架构直接源自决策树集成的神经模型。每条从根节点到叶节点父节点的决策路径被映射为一个隐藏神经元，而矩阵W1（特征到分支）和W2（分支到类别）编码了由教师树集成所诱导的结构关系。这在教师分支与神经组件之间建立了明确的对应关系，使得在保留基于梯度优化的灵活性的同时，能够实现特征级和分支级的可解释性。本文研究的主要配置通过基于梯度的学习来训练由教师模型导出的特征到分支矩阵W1，同时保持分支到类别矩阵W2固定，该配置记为SBN1,0。在29个多分类表格数据集上，该配置在28个数据集上超越了教师树集成，将平均准确率从84.0%提升至87.9%。作为参考，X
tldr: 符号分支网络将决策树集成的结构直接映射为神经网络架构，并通过梯度优化特征到分支矩阵，在29个表格数据集中的28个上超越教师树集成，平均准确率从84.0%提升至87.9%，同时保持了可解释性。
en_tdlr: Symbolic Branch Networks directly map a decision tree ensemble's structure into a neural architecture, and gradient-based optimization of the feature-to-branch matrix surpasses the teacher ensemble on 28 of 29 tabular datasets, raising mean accuracy from 84.0% to 87.9% while retaining interpretability.
